away.name: Jake Oettinger
away.news: Oettinger was stellar in his most recent game, stopping all 22 shots he faced to lead a 2-0 shutout win over the Buffalo Sabres. That said, the 27-year-old Oettinger has been wildly inconsistent this season. Oettinger leads the NHL with four shutouts, but has a sub- .900 SV% in seven of 15 games this season (10-4-1). The Stars enter Tuesday's game as +109 road underdogs against a Vegas Golden Knights team coming off a disappointing 6-3 loss to the Vancouver Canucks.

home.name: Adin Hill
home.news: The Golden Knights have had a liberal goalie rotation in recent weeks and will continue that trend on Tuesday, turning to Adin Hill. After posting a career-worst 3.04 GAA and .871 SV% in 27 games last season (10-9-6), Hill has bounced back, posting a 2.47 GAA and .908 SV% in 10 games (7-2-1). He has a 1.62 GAA and a .943 SV% in his last three games (2-0-1). The Golden Knights enter Thursday's game as -130 home favourites against the Dallas Stars, who are 5-1-1 in their last seven games.

away.name: Dustin Wolf
away.news: Before being sidelined with a lower-body injury, Devin Cooley owned the crease in Calgary, but he has struggled since returning. Meanwhile, Dustin Wolf seems to have found his game during Cooley's absence. The 25-year-old Wolf was excellent in his most recent outing, saving 29 of 31 shots (.935 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Los Angeles Kings. In his last five games (3-1-1), Wolf has a solid 2.22 GAA and a .920 SV%. The Flames enter Tuesday's game as +116 road underdogs against the San Jose Sharks, whom they defeated 2-1 earlier this month.

home.name: Yaroslav Askarov
home.news: Askarov had a rough performance in his previous outing, allowing five goals on 32 shots (.844 SV%), but managed to win 6-5 in a shootout over the Utah Mammoth. The 24-year-old Russian goalie has had an inconsistent season. In 15 games this season (6-8-1), Askarov has allowed four or more goals six times, but has allowed two or fewer seven times. The Sharks enter Tuesday's game as -127 home favourites against a Calgary Flames team coming off a 6-1 loss to the Anaheim Ducks.
